 Order

The petitioners are before this Court calling in question the registration of a crime in Crime No.82/2022 registered for offences punishable under Sections 406 and 420 read with Section 34 of the IPC.
2 . During the pendency of these proceedings, it transpires that the parties to the lis have entered into a settlement and have placed on record such settlement along with the affidavit.

Terms of settlement reads as follows:
"AFFIDAVIT I,Kuber Raj.K Aged about 56 years, S/o Late Krishna Jettappa, R/at No 01/3, Hebbadi Village, Corporation Building, Devaraja Matan Market, Devaraj,
Mysuru- 570001.

do hereby solemnly affirm and state on oath as follows:
1.

I submit that, The Petitioners have filed the above criminal petition before this Hon'bleCourt seeking for quash the First Information Report and Complaint in Crime No.82/2022 (PCR No.36/2022) registered by the 1st Respondent/Devaraja Police Station, Mysuru for the offences punishable under section 406, 420 and read with section 34 of Indian Penal Code.
2. I submit that, This Hon'bleCourt after hearing the petitioners ordered notice to the respondents and passed interim order of stay for the further investigation.
I submit that, The petitioners and me have amicable settled or differences in the all fact and came forward and thereby both the parties have agreed to terminate for the cases for good.
5. I submit that, The Petitioners have claimed the total sum Rs.1,06,01,295/- (Rupees One Crores Six Lakh One Thousand Two Hundred and Ninety Five Only) are liable to be paid by the respondent.
At the intervention of the elders, friends have agreed to settle the differences between and petitioners and me.

Accordingly, the following terms are agreed upon:
6.I submit that.
I have agreed to pay the sum of Rs. 60,00,000/- (Rupees Sixty Lakh Only) to the petitioners through Demand Draftbearing No.475255, dated 05-06- 2024, drawn on State Bank of India.
Yadavagiri Branch, Mysuru.
The copy of the Demand Draft herein enclosed.

7. I submit that, The petitioners have filed the case against me under section 138 of Negotiable Instrument Act in Bangalore and the same is registered in CC.No.3804/2022 pending before the Hon'ble XXIV Additional SCJ and Additional Chief Metropolitan Magistrate, Bangalore(SCCH-26).

The Petitioners have filed recovery suit in Commercial Original Suit No.116/2023 before the Hon'ble II Additional District and Session Judge at Mysore for sum of Rs.1,06,01,295/- (Rupees One Crore Six Lakh One Thousand Two Hundred and Ninety Five Only) of which the petitioners have agreed to withdraw both the cases.
